To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

interrupted Povarov reaction catalyzed by tritylium cations afforded cis-4-amino-2,3-dihydropyrano- and furanobenzodihydro-pyrans within 10 minutes in excellent yields (up to 90%) with low catalyst loadings (1 mol %) in batch mode.
the interrupted Povarov reaction is an efficient method for the synthesis of cis-4-aminebenzodihydropyran derivatives.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a continuous flow protocol for the interrupted Povarov reaction, in which the carbocation tritylium cations act as organocatalyst.
the development of a new catalytic system based on the tritylium cations for the interrupted Povarov reaction of indoles with N-protected amines and activated alkenes.
the synthesis of cis-fused benzodihydropyran derivatives via interrupted Povarov reaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
interrupted Povarov reaction is a versatile tool in synthesis of a variety of pyran derivatives.
interrupted Povarov reaction can be performed with carbocation catalyst in excellent yields and short reaction times.
carbocations are a powerful and versatile catalysts for interrupted Povarov reaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a novel carbocation catalyzed interrupted version of the Povarov reaction and applied the reaction to the continuous flow synthesis of cis-4-amine benzodihydropyran.
we successfully applied a Lewis acidic organocatalyst, tritylium cations, in a Povarov reaction, and the resulting product is a benzodihydropyran with an amine moiety in the 4-position.
the Povarov reaction can now be performed in a flow mode with high yields and short residence time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the carbocation catalysis mechanism can be applied in interrupted Povarov reaction.
carbocation organocatalysts could provide a promising strategy for interrupted Povarov cyclization reactions to afford cis-fused heterocycles in excellent yields.
carbocationic catalysis is a viable alternative to Lewis acid catalysis in interrupted Povarov reaction.
